prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in Houston, Texas, and has whiplash. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1468; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision you were involved in on a Houston roadway. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Can you describe where you were driving and what the traffic was like at the time?

A: I was heading east on a main road in the city. Traffic had slowed down quite a bit, and I was stopped behind a line of cars at a light.

Q: What happened next?

A: The car behind me didn't stop in time. I felt a hard jolt from the back and my head snapped forward and then back against the headrest.

Q: Did you notice any injuries right away?

A: Not at first. I felt a little dazed, but I got out and talked to the other driver. Later that evening my neck got stiff and the pain started spreading into my shoulders.

Q: Have you seen a doctor or other medical provider since the collision?

A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic the next morning. They diagnosed whiplash and gave me a neck brace and some medication. I'm also scheduled for physical therapy.

Q: Are you still experiencing symptoms today?

A: Yes. I have headaches most days, and turning my head to check mirrors when I drive is painful. I've also had trouble sleeping.

Q: Did you miss any time from work because of your injuries?

A: I missed a few days and I'm working modified duties now.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: No, I think that covers it. I'm hoping to recover fully and get back to normal.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
